text:
nora: FYI - restore job 913 failed in us-central1 with KMS AccessDenied while decrypting snapshot metadata. Noticed 3 similar failures across tenants between 01:04-01:12 UTC.
kai: I ran an RBAC tighten yesterday evening, removed broad editor bindings from backup and archive service accounts. Could be related.
priya: Can you paste the exact error?
nora: Log: 
```
2026-04-02T01:05:21Z restore-913 ERROR Decrypt failed: AccessDenied: projects/prod/.../cryptoKeys/tenant-shared-key: permission cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt denied for serviceAccount:archive@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
zach: Also seeing a gap in audit entries for KMS policy changes from 00:58-01:06 UTC, correlates with the failures. @audit-bot any record?
audit-bot: auditlog: missing entries for project=prod window=2026-04-02T00:58:00Z..2026-04-02T01:06:00Z logging-agent restarted at 2026-04-02T01:02:13Z
kai: Ugh, the logging agent restart may have dropped our short-lived policy changes. I did remove a binding that included roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter for archive@ service. I can re-add it.
priya: Before we re-add, can we check the key state? If primaryVersion is disabled a grant won't help.
kms-bot: key-metadata: tenant-shared-key primaryVersionState=ENABLED primaryVersion=3 lastRotate=2026-03-30T09:00:00Z
priya: Key looks enabled. Kai, if you re-grant please record the change and include a brief reason.
kai: Re-applying grant now: 
```bash
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding tenant-shared-key \
  --member=serviceAccount:archive@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --keyring=prod-keys --location=global
```
audit-bot: IAM policy change recorded: user=kai@redwood.ai action=add-iam-policy-binding resource=tenant-shared-key
nora: Retried a canary restore after the grant - still failing for two older jobs with error "invalid-ciphertext". Those look like uploader issues where objects might lack encrypt headers.
zach: I queried object metadata for those parts; some missing x-goog-encryption headers. Uploader v2.1.0 had a race that dropped metadata on multipart commit.
priya: Action items: 1) Kai - revert RBAC prune to whitelist KMS decrypters for backup/archive SAs and open a hotfix PR. 2) Zach - run a scan for objects uploaded in the window 00:30-02:00 UTC for missing encryption metadata and tag for reupload. 3) Priya - add a pre-deploy CI lint that detects KMS-binding removals affecting critical SAs. 4) Engineering - implement a restore worker patch to retry decrypt with renewed grant if remaining grant TTL <30m.
kai: Hotfix PR opened linking this thread, I'll include the IAM audit snapshot in the PR.
nora: Filing an incident INC-2026-0099 and attaching the logs + audit-bot entries.
audit-bot: incident INC-2026-0099 created by nora@redwood.ai linked_audit_entries=3
priya: Also proposing a watch: if logging-agent restarts, spawn a short-lived preservation job that tails /var/log/audit and forwards to durable store until agent backfills. Saves a hole in the chain.
zach: I like that. I'll prototype the preserve tailer this sprint.
kai: Sorry for the outage, learned lesson on whitelisting KMS roles.
nora: Thanks team, we have a recovery plan. Closing triage when hotfix is merged and scan completes. :thumbsup:
